Package net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.models.entities

Class WPSiteInfo

java.lang.Object
net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.models.entities.WPSiteInfo
public final class WPSiteInfo extends Object
Holds the site information required to interact with a WordPress site.

Stores the WordPress base URI and application-password credentials.
